latestVersion.changelog:
ai-image-to-video-leaderboard 1.0.0 — initial release

- Convert still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC up to 200MB) into animated 1080p MP4 video clips using cloud GPUs.
- Allows side-by-side comparison and ranking of different AI image-to-video models.
- Automatic connection setup with session and anonymous token management (100 free credits on sign up).
- Supports multiple workflows: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
- Export, balance checks, and state/status accessible via simple commands; full API error handling included.
- All processing and rendering handled server-side — no local installation needed.
